title: a latched waiting state, so the blocked-session signal can finally be true

AC1.note: resolvePhase(stage, awaitingPermission) exported; returns waiting when held, detectPhase otherwise

AC2.note: five stages covering running, reading, writing, searching and thinking each asserted twice — classifier result, then waiting while held

AC3.note: empty stage returns null unheld and waiting while held

AC4.note: StatusManager holds a HoldCounter keyed by stateKey, exposes holdAwaitingPermission, and computes the phase via resolvePhase at the single former detectPhase site

AC5.note: HoldCounter counts; tests cover two overlapping holders, release order independence, double-release not consuming another hold, and a stale lease after the key was retaken

AC6.note: pollForResponse acquires before the wait and releases in a finally; the lease is captured so no exit is enumerated — answered, resolved externally, timed out and thrown all release

AC7.note: pollForResponse is called once, at permissions.ts on the sendResult.ok path; the send-failure branch returns before it

AC8.note: bun run typecheck clean; bun run lint 0 errors (209 warnings, pre-existing); 618 unit tests pass, none skipped or removed

AC9.note: keryx health run: coverage 17.96% (was 17.83% at flow start), gate WARN on coverage only

AC10.note: PR #42 carries a Verification limit section: the lifecycle is verified by the scope construct and by reading every exit, not end to end; Codex's note that fakes would suffice is recorded in the journal as the next step
